groups.label: Explainers
groups.blurb: Whole product videos from one params file, plus polish for real screen recordings.

groups.label: Motion B-roll
groups.blurb: One shape that never cuts, driven by a cursor, timed to the speaker’s words.

groups.label: Infographics
groups.blurb: Real numbers on springs: bars, lines, donuts, odometers, timelines.

groups.label: Cards
groups.blurb: Feature cards that stack, flip, deal, assemble and notify.

groups.label: Kinetic titles
groups.blurb: Type that slams, decodes, morphs, rotates and hides behind you.

groups.label: Transitions
groups.blurb: Objects that cover the cut — no cross-dissolves.

groups.label: Titles & A-roll
groups.blurb: The original selection-box system for Reels and YouTube.

groups.label: 3D
groups.blurb: Extruded type, a selection gizmo, pop-up paper, polaroids — three.js.

groups.label: Overlays
groups.blurb: Transparent ProRes 4444 layers for your own footage in any editor.

templates.name: x-hype
templates.title: High-energy promo (12–20 s)
templates.description: Beat-locked hype piece: a spark floods into the brand slam, a kinetic triplet, a 3D cube-field signature, a product micro-moment with cursor and toast, a morph bridge and an end card. HUD viewfinder throughout.

ui.heading: What will you build?
ui.prompt: A booking app for my yoga studio

templates.best: Launch teasers, Product Hunt and social ads — 15 seconds that land on every beat.

templates.name: x-demo
templates.title: Product demo (30–90 s)
templates.description: Calm SaaS demo: “Introducing”, the name in a selection box, short lines the camera pushes into with a signal highlight, the product UI rebuilt up close (prompt typing, agent steps, a table filling, chat, a real chart), integrations, a rotating-word closer and an end card.

defaults.problem: Still editing every reel by hand?

features.title: Describe the video you want.

defaults.integrationsLine: Built for the tools you already use.
defaults.tagline: Edit at the speed of thought.

templates.best: Homepage hero videos, feature walkthroughs, sales and investor demos.

templates.name: x-journey
templates.title: One-take journey (10–16 s loop)
templates.description: A white ball starts as a toggle’s knob, rolls a slider to 100, bounces down notification cards that pop as it hits them, hops across a keyboard typing a word, hits return and is launched back while the camera pulls out to reveal the whole course, then dives back. Loops seamlessly.
templates.best: Landing-page loops that show a whole workflow in one take.

templates.name: sr-zoom
templates.title: Screen recording: zooms, clicks, spotlight, notes
templates.description: Your screen recording (video or image) in a browser frame on paper; the camera eases into each zoom region and back, clicks ripple, a spotlight + selection box marks the element, handwritten notes point at it. Coordinates are in recording pixels.
templates.best: Polishing a real screen recording: tutorials, release notes, support videos.

templates.name: mb-launch
templates.title: Launch: pill → card → picker
templates.description: A dark pill with the name and a New badge morphs into a white card about it, then into a segmented picker the cursor clicks through.

card.title: Build anything
card.sub: From one prompt to a live app

templates.best: Announcing a model, plan or feature; choosing between options.

templates.name: mb-terminal
templates.title: Folder → terminal → agent steps
templates.description: A folder is double-clicked open into a terminal, a prompt types out, the agent starts, the shape becomes a checklist that ticks off on words.

defaults.title: yoga-app — agent
defaults.prompt: Build a booking app for my yoga studio with class sign-ups.

templates.best: Developer tools, CLIs and AI agents doing the work.

templates.name: mb-doc
templates.title: Notes → document → drag into a session
templates.description: A notes card fills section by section on words, becomes a document that writes itself, shrinks to a file chip the cursor drags into a session pill.
templates.best: Notes becoming a document; briefs and specs handed to an AI session.

templates.name: mb-slider
templates.title: Slider builds a result
templates.description: A card with a slider: the cursor drags it from low to high and a row of tiles lights up as the value crosses each threshold, with a live tooltip.
templates.best: Effort, quality or price levels — “more of X gives you Y”.

templates.name: mb-versus
templates.title: Side-by-side comparison
templates.description: A pill names the setup, then morphs into an A vs B card: each side gets a relative bar on its word, the badge flips to the verdict.
templates.best: Model vs model, plan vs plan, old way vs new way.

templates.name: mb-checklist
templates.title: Checklist ticks off
templates.description: A titled card where each task appears with a spinner and turns into a check on its word; ends on a confirmation chip.
templates.best: Setup steps, launch lists, “everything I do before I post”.

templates.name: mb-search
templates.title: Search → filter → pick
templates.description: A search pill types a query, opens into a results card that filters as it types, the highlight lands on a row and the cursor picks it.
templates.best: Finding something: search, filter, pick a result.

templates.name: mb-chart
templates.title: Chart card
templates.description: A card with a bar chart (or line chart) whose bars rise on their words, one accent bar, then a tooltip on the point that matters. Relative values unless you pass real ones.
templates.best: A trend or number the speaker mentions in passing.

templates.name: mb-chapter
templates.title: Chapter card
templates.description: A small “Up next →” pill grows into an ink chapter card: the number in the accent, the title, a muted subtitle.
templates.best: Chapter breaks inside a talking-head video.

templates.name: mb-drop
templates.title: File drag → drop → upload
templates.description: A file tile is dragged by the cursor onto a dashed drop zone, the zone accepts it, morphs into an upload bar that fills and checks.
templates.best: Uploading, importing, dragging a file into a tool.

templates.name: mb-toggles
templates.title: Settings toggles
templates.description: A settings card with labelled toggles; the cursor flips each one on its word, the last one turns on a highlighted feature.
templates.best: Settings, switches, features turned on.

templates.name: ig-bars
templates.title: Bar chart
templates.description: Kicker + title, bars rise one after another on springs with values counting, one accent bar, optional note on the accent bar.
templates.best: Comparing a handful of values: days, categories, channels.

templates.name: ig-line
templates.title: Line chart + headline number
templates.description: A headline number rolls up (odometer) while the line draws behind a leading dot; the tooltip pops on the last point.
templates.best: Growth over time with one headline number.

templates.name: ig-donut
templates.title: Donut + legend
templates.description: A ring draws segment by segment (one accent segment), the centre number counts, the legend rows blur in with their shares.
templates.best: Shares of a whole: traffic sources, budget splits.

templates.name: ig-counter
templates.title: Big number
templates.description: One big number rolls up like an odometer in the display face, a label types in, a relative bar fills, the glyph trio stamps. For real stats only.
templates.best: One big real stat: views, users, revenue, hours saved.

templates.name: ig-compare
templates.title: Before / after
templates.description: Two columns: each number counts up with its bar; the winner gets the accent and a selection box; a handwritten verdict.
templates.best: Before / after and old way / new way, as two numbers.

templates.name: ig-timeline
templates.title: Timeline / roadmap
templates.description: A line draws across (down on Reels); each milestone dot stamps as the line reaches it and its label blurs in; the last one is the accent.
templates.best: Roadmaps, histories and launch plans.

templates.name: ig-flow
templates.title: Process / how it works
templates.description: Numbered process: each node stamps in with its icon, the connector draws to the next, the last node is the accent result.
templates.best: “How it works” in three to five steps.

templates.name: ig-ranking
templates.title: Ranking race
templates.description: Horizontal bars that grow and re-sort over time (bar-race lite); the item the story is about is the accent.
templates.best: Leaderboards and rankings that change over time.

templates.name: card-stack
templates.title: Card stack flick-through
templates.description: A stack of feature cards in perspective; the front card flicks away on each beat and the stack springs forward, ending on the last card.

cards.title: Cut on the beat
cards.body: Every cut lands on a downbeat.

templates.best: Feature lists and tips, flicked through on the beat.

templates.name: card-flip
templates.title: Card flip (front → back)
templates.description: A card drops in showing a question or a before; it flips in 3D to reveal the answer or the after on the accent side.

back.title: 10 minutes
back.body: Describe it. Review it. Post it.

templates.best: Question → answer, myth → fact, before → after.

templates.name: card-deal
templates.title: Deal a hand of cards
templates.description: Cards fly out of a deck one by one into a fanned row (a column on Reels), settle on drop springs, then the chosen card lifts and gets the selection box.
templates.best: Picking one option out of several: plans, tools, picks.

templates.name: card-bento
templates.title: Bento grid assembles
templates.description: A feature grid of tiles that blur-scale in one after another, each with a live mini-UI: a counter, bars, a toggle, a ring, avatars, a line of copy.

tiles.title: One accent. One idea per shot.

templates.best: A product overview: every feature at a glance.

templates.name: card-notify
templates.title: Notification stack
templates.description: Notifications drop in at the top one by one; older ones slide down and compress into a stack behind, like a lock screen.
templates.best: Activity, alerts and “what happens next”.

templates.name: card-quote
templates.title: Quote card
templates.description: A quote card: the accent quote mark stamps, the words blur in, the key phrase gets the signal plate, then the name and role. Use real quotes only.

defaults.quote: Put a real quote from a real person here, with the line that matters highlighted.
defaults.name: Their Name

templates.best: A real customer or press quote with the key line on the plate.

templates.name: t-slam
templates.title: Brand slam
templates.description: A mono kicker decodes, the name rises letter by letter on sixteenth notes, a full stop stamps, a handwritten line writes on underneath.
templates.best: Brand intros and sign-offs; the name of a product or series.

templates.name: t-morph
templates.title: Weight / width morph
templates.description: The brand face morphs on its axes: thin and condensed with wide tracking → black and expanded (the display cut), then the second word lands in the accent.
templates.best: Intros where the word itself transforms.

templates.name: t-decode
templates.title: Signal decode
templates.description: Mono kicker and a display title scramble through glyphs and lock left to right like a signal coming in; an accent rule draws under it; corner brackets frame it.
templates.best: Tech launches, drops and “incoming transmission” openers.

templates.name: t-highlight
templates.title: Line + push-in + highlight
templates.description: One short line fades in word by word, the camera pushes in until it spans the frame, the key phrase gets the signal plate. The calm-explainer title.
templates.best: Calm explainer lines and the one phrase to remember.

templates.name: t-rotator
templates.title: Rotating word
templates.description: A sentence with a slot: the word in the slot (on a signal plate) cycles through the list; the line re-flows smoothly as the slot changes width.
templates.best: One sentence, many use cases: “Do all your ___ in Product.”

templates.name: t-wall
templates.title: Outline wall + slam
templates.description: The word repeated as outlined rows sliding in alternate directions fills the frame; the solid word slams in on a band. The loudest beat in a hype piece.
templates.best: The loudest beat of a hype edit; a one-word manifesto.

templates.name: t-stack
templates.title: Stacked kinetic lines
templates.description: Three or four short lines stack up, each sliding out of its own mask from alternating sides on the beat; one line sits on a signal plate. Built for Reels.
templates.best: Reels hooks and recaps in three or four short lines.

templates.name: t-countdown
templates.title: Countdown 3 · 2 · 1
templates.description: Numbers slam on each beat with a tick, rotating in from alternating sides, a 2-frame flash, then the word lands.
templates.best: Openers, launches and “three things” intros.

templates.name: t-behind
templates.title: Title behind the subject
templates.description: Your footage, a huge display word that rises between the background and you, and you on top (cut out frame by frame from masks made by tools/separate.py).
templates.best: Episode and chapter titles that sit behind the person in shot.

templates.name: tr-flood
templates.title: Line → flood
templates.description: A thin accent line draws across, wobbles, then floods the frame (cover at CUT) and slides away to reveal the next shot.
templates.best: Bold section changes in the brand colour.

templates.name: tr-dot
templates.title: Dot → iris
templates.description: A dot grows from a point into a full-frame disc (cover at CUT), then irises out to reveal the next shot.
templates.best: Focusing on one point, then revealing the next shot.

templates.name: tr-bars
templates.title: Bars wipe
templates.description: Staggered ink bars (one in the accent) close over the frame, hold 2 frames for the cut, then open the other way.
templates.best: Rhythmic section changes on a downbeat.

templates.name: tr-zoom
templates.title: Word zooms through
templates.description: A word pops in and flies at the camera until its letters swallow the frame; the fill colour takes over at CUT, then wipes away.
templates.best: Flying into the next chapter through a word.

templates.name: chapter
templates.title: Chapter card
templates.description: Blurred night footage, HUD corners, two tickers, red title selected in a gizmo box, wiped subtitle, 2-frame flash in.
templates.best: Chapter cards over your own blurred footage.

templates.name: hook
templates.title: Hook / intro
templates.description: Graph paper. A big word rises letter by letter with your cutout as the last letter, a handwritten aside points at you, the glyph trio stamps, then a torn night panel brings in two polaroids.

defaults.name: [Your Name]
defaults.line: I make [what you make]. In the next 60 seconds I'll show you exactly how.

polaroids.caption: day 01. no idea what I'm doing

templates.best: Reel intros with your cutout as a letter.

templates.name: talking
templates.title: Talking head — captions & callouts
templates.description: A-roll with word-timed captions (active word on a red plate), a step chip, a selection-box callout around an object, a handwritten note with an arrow and a punch-in word.
templates.best: Talking-head A-roll: captions, callouts and punch words.

templates.name: lowerthird
templates.title: Lower third + B-roll
templates.description: A-roll with a REC timecode HUD, a notebook card dropping in, a B-roll polaroid and a two-bar lower third (name / role + handle).
templates.best: Introducing a speaker, with a REC HUD and a B-roll polaroid.

templates.name: endcard
templates.title: End card
templates.description: Graph paper sign-off: glyph trio, a giant word rising, YouTube end-screen slots (yt) or a follow CTA (reel), a handwritten nudge and a contact row.
templates.best: YouTube end screens and Reels follow CTAs.

templates.name: 3d-title
templates.title: 3D gizmo title
templates.description: Extruded title (red face, ink sides) lands inside a red 3D selection gizmo; camera swings from 3/4 to front; ticker on the floor; HUD on top.
templates.best: Section titles inside a 3D selection gizmo.

templates.name: 3d-popup
templates.title: 3D pop-up paper
templates.description: Title lying on graph paper pops up like a pop-up book; glyph trio stamps in above it.
templates.best: Chapter openers that pop up off graph paper.

templates.name: 3d-ring
templates.title: 3D ticker ring
templates.description: An extruded word with a ticker band orbiting it like a planet ring. Night world, red rim light.
templates.best: Channel and brand idents with an orbiting ticker.

templates.name: 3d-polaroids
templates.title: 3D polaroid fly-through
templates.description: Polaroids hang in the dark; the camera moves-and-holds from one to the next and lands on the hero shot.
templates.best: Story recaps, milestones, behind the scenes.

templates.name: ov-title
templates.title: Selection title (overlay)
templates.description: Just the selected title + optional subtitle, transparent. Put it over blurred footage.
templates.best: A selected title over any footage in your editor.

templates.name: ov-ticker
templates.title: Ticker band (overlay)
templates.description: A single linear ticker band. Loopable: set duration to a multiple of the cycle or let it run.
templates.best: A running ticker band over footage.

templates.name: ov-hud
templates.title: HUD corners (overlay)
templates.description: Four corner labels typing on, 1 character per frame.
templates.best: Viewfinder HUD corners over footage.

templates.name: ov-lowerthird
templates.title: Lower third (overlay)
templates.description: Name bar + role/handle bar sliding in, glyph stamp, sliding out.
templates.best: Name and role bars over your own A-roll.

templates.name: ov-captions
templates.title: Word captions (overlay)
templates.description: Word-timed captions from a transcript ([{text,start,end}] in seconds). Active word on a red plate.
templates.best: Word-timed captions with the active word on the plate.

templates.name: ov-punch
templates.title: Punch word (overlay)
templates.description: A red sticker word slams in (scale 220→94→100, rotate −30°→−6°) and jitters.
templates.best: One-word sticker emphasis — “Wait.” “Nope.”

templates.name: ov-callout
templates.title: Callout box (overlay)
templates.description: Selection rectangle with handles, tag and live dimensions around anything in your shot.
templates.best: Pointing at an object in your shot, with live dimensions.

templates.name: ov-chip
templates.title: Step chip (overlay)
templates.description: "STEP 03 / 05" band sliding in from the left edge.
templates.best: “Step 02 / 05” progress chips.

templates.name: ov-note
templates.title: Handwritten aside (overlay)
templates.description: Caveat note writing on with an arrow drawing toward a point.
templates.best: Handwritten asides with an arrow to the thing.

templates.name: tr-torn
templates.title: Torn-paper wipe
templates.description: A torn panel (ink or paper) sweeps across, fully covers the frame for 2 frames (cut underneath) and exits.
templates.best: Torn-paper cuts between night and paper.

templates.name: tr-flash
templates.title: 2-frame flash
templates.description: White (or red) for 2 frames. Place frame 0 on the cut.
templates.best: A 2-frame hit on a downbeat cut.

templates.name: tr-ticker
templates.title: Ticker wipe
templates.description: A ticker band grows to fill the frame, holds 2 frames for the cut, collapses.
templates.best: A ticker band that fills the frame on the cut.

templates.name: tr-paper-roll
templates.title: 3D paper roll (chapter transition)
templates.description: A graph-paper page unrolls up over the frame carrying a chapter title, holds, then rolls away. Transparent outside the page; cut under the hold.
templates.best: Chapter changes that unroll a page in 3D.

tokens.colorRule: Signal red is the only loud colour on screen. Use it for display titles, HUD text, outlines and plates. Never red body copy on paper; use signalDeep for small red text on paper.

eases.name: stamp
eases.use: glyph stamps, handles popping, polaroid drops (overshoot)

eases.name: wipe
eases.use: torn-paper wipes, panel pushes, 3D camera moves between holds

eases.name: write
eases.use: handwriting write-on, arrow and circle strokes

springs.name: morph
springs.use: the one shape changing size, radius and colour between states

springs.name: fast
springs.use: leading edge of a moving indicator (it stretches), items sliding under a highlight

springs.name: slow
springs.use: trailing edge of a moving indicator

springs.name: soft
springs.use: camera-like content moves, large panels, focus shifts

springs.name: stamp
springs.use: glyph stamps, check marks, the punch of a slam (overshoot on small things only)

springs.name: settle
springs.use: default for UI values (bars, sliders, counters)

springs.name: drop
springs.use: cards dropping into a stack, polaroids

swap.use: content inside a morphing container: exit blurs out fast, entry waits din then blurs in over lin

cursor.rule: Moves on gentle curves, arrives a beat before it clicks, constant size on screen at every zoom, never leaves the frame.

camera.rule: The camera is the editor in calm pieces: push into a line, ride the action, pull back to show where you are, glide on. No hard cuts inside a scene.

radius.unit: px at 1080 on the short side; scale with the frame

mix.measure: on the exported MP4, stereo and mono

do: One idea per shot. Hold every title at least 18 frames after it lands.
Enter titles as a selection: box draws (6f) → handles pop (4f) → type lands 112%→100% (12f).
Keep tickers linear and continuous; they never ease or stop.
Put HUD labels in the corners, 64-72 px from the edges (inside safe zones on Reels).
Behind any title, blur and darken the footage and push it in slowly.
Use handwriting (Caveat, pen blue on paper / white on night) for asides, with an arrow that points at the thing.
Cut on downbeats. Use a 2-frame white flash or a torn-paper wipe for section changes.
Explainers: one idea per scene, one line of text OR one UI element on screen, the camera does the storytelling (push in, ride, pull back).
Motion B-roll: one shape that never cuts; every state change lands on a spoken word; a cursor drives the changes with real clicks and drags.
Transitions in hype pieces are objects, not cuts: a line floods the frame, a dot grows into the next background, a word zooms through the camera.
Every visible interaction gets one real sound: clicks click, toggles tick, cards pop, slams hit, camera moves whoosh.
dont: No second loud colour. No gradients on type, no glows, no lens flares, no RGB split, no camera shake.
No bouncy easing on large moves (overshoot is only for small stamps, handles and drops).
Brand devices (title plates, tickers, chips, selection boxes, punch words) have square edges and 1.5-3 px outlines. Rounded corners only appear on rebuilt product UI (the Interface layer, ui.radius).
No invented numbers, testimonials, ratings or logos. Without real figures use relative bars, skeleton lines and labels from the script.
No bouncy easing on cameras or large panels; no particles or glows on UI; no more than one accent per scene.
No emoji. Icons are the glyph trio (star, sparkle, plus) or simple stroke icons.
Never put text in the Reels UI zones (top 220 px, bottom 420 px, right 140 px).
